title: The answer key keeps the obviously broken reference in 'Change in NWC' (R84 =R847-M83, which points at an empty cell). An agent that fixes it to =R83-M83, as the prompt's 'broken cell references' item requires, changes R84, D94, D95, C102 and every DCF output, and so fails the exact-match check.
evidence: gt_08_golden.xlsx 'Operating Model + DCF'!R84 = '=R847-M83' (-29.613); the correct value is R83-M83 ≈ -113.9. R84, C95:H100, C102 and C107:C145 all fall inside the compared range A2:X145.
confirmation: Golden 'Operating Model + DCF'!R84 is still '=R847-M83', which points at an empty R847 (value -29.61), while M84 follows the pattern =M83-H83.
